items.text: CONTAINER SHIP SINKS AFTER HITTING MINE NEAR STRAIT OF HORMUZ Iran’s Revolutionary Guards say a container ship carrying over 2,500 containers sank after striking a naval mine and catching fire south of the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. INFLATION RUNS HOTTER THAN HEADLINE NUMBERS SUGGEST Unrounded September CPI rose 0.649% MoM, beating the 0.58% forecast, while core CPI climbed 0.335% vs. 0.21% expected. GASOLINE DRIVES MORE THAN HALF OF U.S. INFLATION SURGE Gasoline prices jumped 9.1% in September, while fuel oil, including diesel, surged 15.3%. Energy costs drove more than half of the monthly CPI increase, pushing annual inflation to 3.7%. Elevated October fuel prices signal continued inflation pressure ahead of the November 3 midterms.

NFLX - NETFLIX CUTS 1,000 JOBS AS SHARES FALL 40% Netflix is laying off 6% of its workforce, its biggest cuts since 2022, amid slowing growth and weaker customer engagement. Shares are down over 40% in the past year. The layoffs come one week before earnings, with Netflix maintaining its full-year outlook.

U.S. INFLATION STAYS ABOVE FED TARGET FOR 66 STRAIGHT MONTHS September CPI rose 3.7% YoY, exceeding expectations and extending inflation's streak above the Fed's 2% target to 66 consecutive months — more than five years. According to Bespoke Investment Group, this marks only the third period in the past century when U.S. inflation has remained above 2% for at least five years. Persistent inflation continues to complicate the Fed's path toward lower interest rates.
